en.headline: WestK Picnic Fest returns this Mid-Autumn weekend by the harbour
en.dek: The Harbourside East Lawn in the Art Park is open 2pm to 9pm from Friday to Sunday, with a food market, workshops and live music through 11 October.
body: West Kowloon Cultural District's first WestK Picnic Fest is running this Mid-Autumn weekend on the Harbourside East Lawn in the Art Park. The district said the lawn is open from 2pm to 9pm on Friday 25 September through Sunday 27 September, part of four blocks of weekends and public holidays from 18 September to 11 October.

Sixteen vendors are offering picnic sets and drinks on the lawn. WestK is renting mats, chairs, tables, lanterns and fans at HK$40 to HK$50 an item. Visitors who buy designated food sets can borrow two foldable chairs the same day. A Bike & Picnic Pass with tokyobike is priced at HK$348 and includes a bicycle, mat and lantern.

The programme includes a gourmet market, themed workshops and live music. Hours on National Day, 1 October, are shortened to 2pm to 6pm for the market. The district listed the other blocks as 1 to 4 October and 9 to 11 October.

zh.headline: 西九Picnic Fest中秋連場開至晚上9時
zh.dek: 藝術公園臨海東草坪本周五至日下午2時至9時開放，設市集、工作坊及現場音樂，活動舉行至10月11日。
body: 西九文化區首次舉辦的WestK Picnic Fest正值中秋連場，於藝術公園臨海東草坪舉行。西九公布，9月25日周五至27日周日每日下午2時至晚上9時開放，同屬9月18日至10月11日期間四個周末及假期時段之一。
草坪上有16個攥檔提供野餐套餐及飲品。西九提供墊、椅、桌、燈籠及風扇租借，每件收費40至50元；購買指定套餐可於當日借用兩張摺椅。與tokyobike合作的單車野餐通行證售348元，包括單車、墊及燈籠。
節目包括美食市集、主題工作坊及現場音樂。國慶日10月1日市集開放時間改為下午2時至6時。其餘場次為10月1日至4日，以及10月9日至11日。
